title: New extensive sampling transforms our understanding of global marine diversity
content:
by Jonathan Belmaker

Scientists still have a very limited understanding of marine biodiversity. A new study in PLOS Biology using unprecedented global environmental DNA (eDNA) sampling reveals the extent of our ignorance and charts the way forward. Scientists still have a very limited understanding of marine biodiversity. This Primer explores a new study in PLOS Biology that uses unprecedented global environmental DNA (eDNA) sampling to reveal the extent of our ignorance.
